entities.summary: Pascweten was the count of Vannes and a claimant to the rule of Brittany. He was a son of Ridoredh of Vannes, a prominent and wealthy aristocrat first associated with the court of Erispoe in the 850s. He owned vast landed estates and salt works in southeastern Brittany and was a patron of Redon Abbey. Pascweten was a monarchs & rulers from Armorica (850 CE, Armorica–877 CE). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to political systems and imperial and colonial studies.
